question: In July 2025, ______ launched a national level initiative SOAR (Skilling for AI readiness).

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution: The correct answer is __**Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **SOAR (Skilling for AI Readiness)** is a national-level initiative launched in **July 2025** by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. This program aims to prepare the workforce for **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**-driven jobs. • The initiative focuses on **upskilling and reskilling** individuals, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary **AI-related technical and analytical skills**. • It aligns with the broader goals of India's **Digital India** mission, fostering innovation and technological growth through **AI adoption**. • This program targets **students, professionals, and young entrepreneurs**, aiming to bridge the gap between industry demands and workforce preparedness. • The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship has been instrumental in launching various programs to enhance the employability of India's youth, making SOAR a significant addition to its portfolio.
